p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 7]
        for a, b in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            if b - a == 2:
                out[r][a + 1] = 2
    return out
''')
